name: Sofistia Greygoose
original_name: ソフィスティア＝グレイグース
source:
A bumbling, glasses-wearing elf girl.
She is the leader of a clan of a certain realm within the game world, but her natural clumsiness and crybaby nature tends to inconvenience the people around her.
Despite this, she has an unexpectedly depraved side and becomes a completely different person in bed.
An extreme masochist, Sofistia becomes insatiable the moment her desire is sparked.
She also has massive tits.
